items.title: Why Policy in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore chose Cedar for securing agentic workflows
items.summary: Agents have agency: they adapt and find multiple ways to solve problems. It can hallucinate harmful actions with complete confidence. It’s vulnerable to prompt injection […]

items.title: Project Glasswing: what Mythos showed us
items.summary: In recent weeks, we pointed Mythos and other security-focused LLMs at live code across critical parts of our infrastructure. We share what we observed, the models’ strengths and weaknesses, and what the work around them needs to look like before any of it can scale.
